scientific_question: Does a deployment-visible, sign-preserving spatial state with geometry-aligned peer residuals close the cross-trajectory support gap that was independently exact under the v149 scalar-summary feature state?
scope: Target-free post-open mechanism audit on the same five opened PoolFire trajectories. It fits no target model, reads no CFD truth or Krylov coordinate target, performs no physical replay, and is not an algorithm, reconstruction, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS result, external test, curved-ray result, or real BOST result.

v149_scalar_summary_control.definition: Sealed v149 local feature plus active-set mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum.

signed_spatial_peer_state.base: The same sealed 61-value v149 local feature.
signed_spatial_peer_state.phase_normalization: For each visible 16x16 map independently, tanh(value / RMS), using exact zero when RMS is at most 1e-30.
signed_spatial_peer_state.self_residual: First 4x4 orthonormal DCT-II coefficients of the signed K1 residual phase for the target camera and detector component, row-major frequency order.
signed_spatial_peer_state.self_dual: First 4x4 orthonormal DCT-II coefficients of the signed exact-K1 dual phase for the same target camera and component.
signed_spatial_peer_state.geometry_aligned_peer_residual: Lift every peer camera residual through its reported right/up axes, average peers in world coordinates, reproject through the target reported right/up axes, normalize signed phase, then retain the first 4x4 orthonormal DCT-II coefficients.
signed_spatial_peer_state.set_aggregation: Append active-group mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum to every local row.

support_audit.split: Complete-trajectory leave-one-trajectory-out over the five opened trajectories.
support_audit.fit_only_normalization: Weighted mean and standard deviation; each sample has total weight one distributed uniformly over its active groups.
support_audit.distance: Root-mean-square Euclidean distance over every fit-standardized coordinate of the state being audited.
support_audit.reference_row_selection: Ascending active-row integer order, deterministic evenly spaced midpoint ranks.
support_audit.reference_neighbor: Exact nearest row from a different fit trajectory in the same camera-count/component stratum.
support_audit.support_threshold: Fit-only higher 90th percentile of reference RMS distances.
support_audit.heldout_neighbor: Exact nearest row across all four fit trajectories in the same camera-count/component stratum.
support_audit.distance_tie_break: Ascending exact distance then ascending global active-row integer index.

non_exchangeable_decision_rule: If parent bindings, target-free feature construction, baseline v150 support reproduction, exact-neighbor construction, fit-only normalization, scoring, or independent recomputation is invalid, return INCONCLUSIVE_SIGNED_SPATIAL_SUPPORT_V151.

If the signed_spatial_peer_state reaches at least 0.9 support in all 40 trajectory-camera-component strata and all 20 trajectory-camera strata, return PASS_SIGNED_SPATIAL_CROSS_TRAJECTORY_SUPPORT_V151. This permits one separately frozen conditional-ambiguity or small-predictor audit but not training now.
Otherwise return FAIL_SIGNED_SPATIAL_CROSS_TRAJECTORY_SUPPORT_V151 and close this signed-spatial state; do not rescue it with a larger CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU.

independent_validation.separate_feature_implementation: SciPy orthonormal dctn plus an independently written world-frame peer alignment; it does not import the formal v151 numerical module.
independent_validation.separate_neighbor_implementation: SciPy cdist in bounded query blocks with stable integer tie breaks; it does not import the formal exact-neighbor helper.

authorization_after_independent_validati.support_pass: Freeze one target-aware conditional-ambiguity audit before any predictor fit; training remains unauthorized.
authorization_after_independent_validati.support_fail: Close the signed-spatial peer state and reassess trajectory/perturbation normalization or the physical target; no larger-model rescue.
